value.env:
INPUT_MODEL=aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5
INPUT_MODEL_NAME=Opus 5.5
INPUT_MODEL_INPUT=text,image
INPUT_MODEL_REASONING=true
INPUT_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOW=1050000
INPUT_MODEL_MAX_TOKENS=128000
INPUT_MODEL_TOOLS_HIDDEN=
key-len 1 26

progress.command: for v in INPUT_MODEL INPUT_MODEL_NAME INPUT_MODEL_INPUT INPUT_MODEL_REASONING INPUT_MODEL_CONTEXT_WINDOW INPUT_MODEL_MAX_TOKENS INPUT_MODEL_TOOLS_HIDDEN; do echo "$v=$(printenv $v)"; done; echo key-len $(printenv INPUT_PROVIDER_API_KEY | wc -c) $(printenv INPUT_API_KEY | wc -c)
progress.output:
INPUT_MODEL=aws/anthropic/bedrock-claude-opus-5-5
